content.title: Protein bar maker David acquires novel fat maker Epogee, raises $75m Series A on back of ‘explosive’ growth
Medici Brands Secures $250M Series B, Valued at $2.25 Billion

results:
Several sources say the protein bar brand David acquired Epogee, the maker of the fat replacer EPG, in May 2025, alongside a $75M Series A.

- **The deal:** The press release dated May 29, 2025 says David closed the round, led by Greenoaks, and bought Epogee to gain supply-chain control. The brand's founder, Peter Rahal, is the RXBAR co-founder. (David, a brand that designs tools to increase muscle and decrease fat, today closed a $75 million Series A funding round)
- **Why it mattered:** David reportedly accounted for about 90% of Epogee's revenue, so it treated EPG supply as critical. ("David accounts for about 90% of Epogee's revenue, so securing supplies of EPG is mission critical for us," Rahal explained.)
- **What EPG does:** It is a low-calorie fat substitute. One source says 1g of fat contains 9 calories, while 1g of EPG contains just 0.7 calories.
- **Aftermath:** Other EPG users sued. One source reports that after acquiring Epogee, Medici limited EPG supply. It cut off other customers. A lawsuit filed in June 2025 by former customers remains ongoing. Another source says Lighten Up Foods recently settled its claims.

**Discrepancy:** One source (Parsers.vc) credits the Epogee acquisition to Medici Brands, not David. That article also describes David Protein as a Medici product, so Medici may be the parent company. The other sources name David as the buyer, and I could not confirm the corporate relationship from these results. The lawsuit reportedly names Medici Brands, Epogee, and Rahal as defendants.

content.text:
**答案：David（David Protein）**。它在 2025 年 5 月随 7500 万美元 A 轮融资一起收购了 EPG 的唯一生产商 Epogee。

- 融资和收购的新闻稿日期是 2025 年 5 月 29 日。融资由 Greenoaks 领投。创始人是 Peter Rahal，也是 RXBAR 的联合创始人。
- David 据称占 Epogee 约 90% 的收入，所以买下它是为了保证 EPG 的供应。
- 有一个来源（Parsers.vc）把收购方写成 Medici Brands。该文把 David 描述为 Medici 旗下产品，所以 Medici 可能是母公司。我没能从这次的搜索结果里确认两者的关系。其余来源都写 David 是收购方。

Sources:
- [Protein bar maker David acquires novel fat maker Epogee, raises $75m Series A (AgFunderNews)](https://agfundernews.com/protein-bar-maker-david-acquires-novel-fat-maker-epogee-raises-75m-series-a-on-back-of-explosive-growth)
- [Business Wire 新闻稿（2025-05-29）](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20250529749264/en/)
- [David Acquires EPG Supplier Epogee (Sacra)](https://sacra.com/chat/h/da6f9b5d-8dad-451d-8e45-6a6d5b113090/)
- [Medici Brands Secures $250M Series B (Parsers.vc)](https://parsers.vc/news/260910-medici-brands-secures-250m-series-b--valued/)
